patch:
diff --git a/src/backend/catalog/system_views.sql b/src/backend/catalog/system_views.sql
index 8612d99a8909e..ad340887f5416 100644
--- a/src/backend/catalog/system_views.sql
+++ b/src/backend/catalog/system_views.sql
@@ -1397,8 +1397,9 @@ CREATE VIEW pg_stat_progress_cluster AS
         datname,
         relid,
         CASE WHEN command IN ('CLUSTER', 'VACUUM FULL') THEN command
-             WHEN repack_index_relid = 0 THEN 'VACUUM FULL'
-             ELSE 'CLUSTER' END AS command,
+             WHEN command = 'REPACK' AND repack_index_relid = 0 THEN 'VACUUM FULL'
+             WHEN command = 'REPACK' THEN 'CLUSTER'
+             END AS command,
         phase,
         repack_index_relid AS cluster_index_relid,
         heap_tuples_scanned,

  */

 #endif
test_patch:
diff --git a/src/test/regress/expected/rules.out b/src/test/regress/expected/rules.out
index 1a29d46213eab..4a8cc759d7b24 100644
--- a/src/test/regress/expected/rules.out
+++ b/src/test/regress/expected/rules.out
@@ -2038,8 +2038,9 @@ pg_stat_progress_cluster| SELECT pid,
     relid,
         CASE
             WHEN (command = ANY (ARRAY['CLUSTER'::text, 'VACUUM FULL'::text])) THEN command
-            WHEN (repack_index_relid = (0)::oid) THEN 'VACUUM FULL'::text
-            ELSE 'CLUSTER'::text
+            WHEN ((command = 'REPACK'::text) AND (repack_index_relid = (0)::oid)) THEN 'VACUUM FULL'::text
+            WHEN (command = 'REPACK'::text) THEN 'CLUSTER'::text
+            ELSE NULL::text
         END AS command,
     phase,
     repack_index_relid AS cluster_index_relid,
problem_statement:
PostgreSQL progress view reports CLUSTER to users without access to command details.

While another session runs REPACK, CLUSTER, or VACUUM FULL, a user lacking permission to view progress details sees CLUSTER in pg_stat_progress_cluster instead of NULL. The command should remain NULL when the user lacks access.
